title: Death of a Detective
summary: DI Poole is found stabbed to death at a villa with his University friends.
method: The killer suggested the group do a social game, knowing Richard would not participate and isolate himself. There was an accomplice who helped the killer establish an alibi by bringing Richard an empty cup of tea after he was killed. Richard had a box of photos and mementos sent from his University days and had a book that ultimately implicated the murderer.
motive: Richard discovered that the killer was assuming her sister's identity after she died in a car crash. This was done after having plastic surgery to look more like her sister.
killer: The friend that Richard had a crush on in University and her husband.
notes:
The University photos of the group are badly photoshopped. I've watched the episode multiple times and it never looks right.
I've always questioned the decision to kill off DI Poole because they make a decision to bring him back later as a ghost that talks to Camille. The story itself is farfetched because it's not clear what Richard expected to accomplish by staying at the reunion and approaching that person about the fraud.
